description: This Java abstract class provides a factory for creating AnnotationBasedJsonParsable instances from annotations. It includes methods for retrieving deserialization keys, method names and fallback keys based on annotations, supporting different API versions.

classes.name: AbstractAnnotationBasedJsonParsableFactory
classes.description: An abstract factory class for creating AnnotationBasedJsonParsable objects from annotations, supporting API versioning and customizable deserialization strategies.

methods.name: fromAnnotation
methods.description: Creates an AnnotationBasedJsonParsable instance from a given annotation and target class, using helper methods to derive relevant properties.

methods.name: getV1FallbackKeyFor
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a fallback key for API v1 deserialization, with default behavior matching the v2 key if no fallback is needed. Deprecated.

methods.name: getKeyFor
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the key used in v2 deserialization strategies from the annotation.

methods.name: getMethodNameFor
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the method name used for deserialization based on the annotation.
